CustomObject.description: The Decision Score type holds one cell of the Pillar B decision matrix: the Score (1 to 5) one option earns on one criterion, with its Rationale and Evidence. Is Placeholder marks a score the owner has not reviewed. Commonly used for scoring.
CustomObject.label: Decision Score

validationRules.description: Every cell of the matrix is scored from 1 (poor fit) to 5 (strong fit).
validationRules.errorMessage: Score must be a number from 1 to 5.
